decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrates (ACT) are a flagship line close to the core offer, they serve fast-growing glass-core packaging and high-frequency markets, and they were still listed in 2024, so a growing firm with slack has no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

VLIS through-glass-via structuring launched in 2024 as a flagship with its own page, its results are not yet judged against aspirations, and the firm is investing and expanding into higher-value semiconductor applications, so it has the slack and strategic reason to keep it.
